title: Paper slips by week
summary: Replaces the table with one paper slip per day, grouped under "Tento týden" / "Minulý týden": flap-style weekday and date tiles (red "Dnes" for today), the question large, a result line ("905 bodů · celá tabule" or "Nehráno") and a clear "Hrát" / "Výsledek" label. The whole slip is the link and turns blue on hover.
tradeoffs: Much more inviting and thumb-friendly, but takes about twice the height per day, so a long archive needs more scrolling (fine for months, would want pagination after a year).
